content.comment_body: What could cause the Run/Stop indicator to switch from green to red on a [product_name] with article number [article_no]? It is connected to a [product_name] ([article_no]) and powered by 24.6V DC.

This may sometimes be due to an issue with the connection between the base and the attached expansion module. Try turning off the power and moving the slider connector back and forth several times. Applying contact spray might also help.
